title: Workflows, agents and who owns the control flow

items.stem: Which statement best separates a workflow from an agent?

options.text: A workflow makes one model call in total, while an agent makes several calls in a row
A workflow cannot use any tools, while an agent is the kind of system that can use them
In a workflow the program's code fixes the order of steps; in an agent the model chooses them
A workflow runs on a smaller, cheaper model, while an agent needs a larger and stronger one

items.stem: Your assistant has the tools check_calendar, search_manuals and book_machine. In a loop, the model picks which tool to call next, and the loop ends when the model writes a final answer. In one sentence, who owns the control flow here, and is this a workflow or an agent?
Which part of the makerspace assistant is the best candidate for a fixed workflow?

options.text: Booking a machine, where the same three steps (check training, check calendar, write the booking) run in that order every time
Answering open questions from students, where the needed manuals and bookings differ and the order of lookups is unclear
Diagnosing a jammed 3D printer, where each next check depends on what the previous check turned up
Planning which machines a student's project needs, where the project description is vague and keeps changing

items.stem: For a task whose steps are known in advance, name two reasons a fixed workflow is a better choice than an agent. Keep your answer to one or two sentences.
Your team is choosing how to build one part of the assistant. Which rule of thumb is best?

options.text: Use an agent for any task with several steps, because the model can handle however many steps are needed
Use an agent whenever accuracy matters most, because the loop lets the model check and correct its own work
Use an agent for any task that needs a tool, because only an agent can call tools on a student's behalf
Use a workflow when you can write the steps down in advance, and an agent only where you cannot predict them

items.stem: A model reads each student message and labels it either "booking" or "manual question". Your code then runs a fixed booking sequence or a fixed manual-lookup sequence to match the label. In one or two sentences, is this a workflow or an agent, and why?
